title: scope_gate output
description: Strict output schema for the scope_gate OpenClaw skill. Decides whether an inbound email is in scope for Phase 1 internal/leadership triage, or out of scope (Gorgias-owned customer email, or unclear). Customer-facing addresses MUST resolve to scope_label='gorgias_owned' and in_scope=false. Unclear inputs MUST default to in_scope=false with scope_label='unknown'.

in_scope.description: true when the email is internal or leadership and should be processed by the chain; false when out of scope (Gorgias-owned or unknown).

reason.description: One sentence naming the specific rule and signals that drove the decision.

signals.description: Literal address fragments, signature words, or subject tags pulled from the email that justified the scope decision.

allOf.description: When scope_label is gorgias_owned, in_scope MUST be false. Customer-facing recipients are never processed by this Phase 1 system.
When scope_label is unknown, in_scope MUST be false. The safe default for an unclear email is to NOT process it.
When scope_label is internal or leadership, in_scope MUST be true. Those two labels are by definition the in-scope cases.
